note: The global SU(2) generators equal the magnetic translations T_x,T_y,T_z (identity in position basis). T_i is a shift (fixed-point-free permutation, diagonal fraction 0), NOT a local spin. So pi-flux SU(2) is a momentum SU(2); paid-bridge-2 = momentum SU(2) -> spin SU(2) = spin connection omega_mu.
